1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __without disrupting embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising one or more of: repeated cycles of cold and heat exposure followed by agitation, heat exposure followed by agitation, or enzymatic digestion with a cell wall degrading enzyme__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __selected from genotyping methods comprising single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of steps (a), (b), and (c)__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in a manner that preserves the viability of non-sampled embryos__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __in a manner that preserves the viability of non-sampled embryos__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected to preserve embryo viability__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using magnetic particles or other non-destructive extraction methods__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the time of collection of shed cellular material in step (a)__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (a) __or between steps (a) and (d)__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without requiring embryo destruction__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __conducted on the DNA obtained in step (b)__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the embryo was germinated after completion of molecular analysis in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained in step (b)__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __determined in step (c) prior to germination in step (d)__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after selection based on genotype__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __including automated genotyping analysis and automated embryo selection__.
